verdict.rationale: DPMA is a patent and trade mark office with online filing and register services. A buyer could reasonably ask how such a service handles retention and deletion of user-submitted data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only search databases, filing routes and a robots.txt probe, with nothing on data retention settings, deletion requests or user-controlled data lifecycle.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
